title: Ai slop (1) Doors auto open
features: Bro u literaly flying to doors and keys
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Настройки по умолчанию
local Config = {
    AutoFarm = false,
    FlySpeed = 60, -- Значение от 0 до 500
    AutoKey = true -- Искать ключ и открывать дверь или просто сразу лететь к двери
}

-- Игровые папки DOORS
local CurrentRooms = Workspace:WaitForChild("CurrentRooms")
local GameData = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameData")

-- Вспомогательная функция перемещения через CFrame
local function moveToCFrame(targetCFrame)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

    humanoid.PlatformStand = true

    while Config.AutoFarm and (hrp.Position - targetCFrame.Position).Magnitude > 2 do
        if not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
        
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        
        -- Полет прямо в точку со заданной скоростью
        local dir = (targetCFrame.Position - hrp.Position).Unit
        local newPos = hrp.Position + (dir * (Config.FlySpeed * RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()))
        
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(newPos, newPos + dir)
    end
    
    if not Config.AutoFarm and humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

-- Функция поиска текущей двери
local function getLatestDoor()
    local latestRoomNum = GameData.LatestRoom.Value
    local room = CurrentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(latestRoomNum))
    if room then
        local door = room:FindFirstChild("Door")
        if door then
            return door, room
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

-- Поиск ключа в комнате
local function getKeyInRoom(room)
    for _, item in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
        if item.Name == "KeyObtain" or item.Name == "Key" then
            local prompt = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
            return item, prompt
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

-- Главный поток автофарма
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if Config.AutoFarm then
            local door, room = getLatestDoor()
            if door and room then
                local doorPart = door:FindFirstChild("Door") or door:FindFirstChild("PrimaryPart") or door
                local lock = door:FindFirstChild("Lock")
                
                -- Если есть замок и включен AutoKey
                if lock and Config.AutoKey then
                    local key, prompt = getKeyInRoom(room)
                    if key then
                        local keyPart = key:IsA("BasePart") and key or key:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if keyPart then
                            -- Летим к ключу
                            moveToCFrame(keyPart.CFrame)
                            
                            -- Забираем ключ
                            if prompt then
                                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.3)
                        end
                    end
                end
                
                -- Летим к двери
                if doorPart then
                    moveToCFrame(doorPart.CFrame)
                    
                    -- Открываем дверь / поворачиваем ручку
                    local doorPrompt = door:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
                    if doorPrompt then
                        fireproximityprompt(doorPrompt)
                    end
                    
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

--- ================= UI ИНТЕРФЕЙС ================= ---

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DoorsHardcoreUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 310)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.25, 0)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true
main.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", main)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", main)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 180)
stroke.Thickness = 1.5

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
title.Text = "👁️ DOORS HARDCORE AUTO-FLY"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
title.TextSize = 14
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Parent = main

-- Кнопка ВКЛ / ВЫКЛ АВТОФАРМ
local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 40)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.18, 0)
toggleBtn.Text = "Авто-Полет: ВЫКЛ"
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleBtn.TextSize = 13
toggleBtn.Parent = main

Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Config.AutoFarm = not Config.AutoFarm
    if Config.AutoFarm then
        toggleBtn.Text = "Auto-fly : true"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 80)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "Auto-Fly : false"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
        
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").PlatformStand = false
        end
    end
end)

-- Переключатель Сбора Ключа
local keyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
keyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 38)
keyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.35, 0)
keyBtn.Text = "find and grab key = true"
keyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 180)
keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
keyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
keyBtn.TextSize = 12
keyBtn.Parent = main

Instance.new("UICorner", keyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

keyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Config.AutoKey = not Config.AutoKey
    if Config.AutoKey then
        keyBtn.Text = "find and grab key = true"
        keyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 180)
    else
        keyBtn.Text = "find and grab key = false"
        keyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    end
end)

-- Настройка скорости полета (0 - 500)
local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 20)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.52, 0)
speedLabel.Text = "CFrame speed (0-500):"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
speedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedLabel.TextSize = 12
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Parent = main

local speedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
speedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 35)
speedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.6, 0)
speedBox.Text = tostring(Config.FlySpeed)
speedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
speedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
speedBox.TextSize = 14
speedBox.Parent = main

Instance.new("UICorner", speedBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

speedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local val = tonumber(speedBox.Text)
    if val then
        Config.FlySpeed = math.clamp(val, 0, 500)
        speedBox.Text = tostring(Config.FlySpeed)
    else
        speedBox.Text = tostring(Config.FlySpeed)
    end
end)
